newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hunt Oil starts exploration in Laos.
newsitem.headline: Hunt Oil starts exploration in Laos.

text.p: Hunt Oil Co, a Texas-based private U.S. oil firm, has started petroleum exploration in Laos, a statement from the American embassy in Vientiane said on Friday.
The concession well for the exploration was in Pakse in Champasak province, southern Laos.
The company planned to drill the well to a depth of 2,500 meters (8,200 feet) to test a feature revealed by an earlier seismic survey conducted by Hunt Oil, the statement said.
Hunt Oil signed a product sharing agreement with the Lao government in 1990. The concession covered an area of 28,800 square km.
Under the agreement, Hunt Oil will provide 100 percent of the investment for the project and share the production with Laos if oil or gas is discovered in viable quantities, the statement added.
